reviewer: editorial review against the QC rubric

reasons.hook: Nine words, an ordinary action against an impossible result. Docked three because 'the conversation' has no antecedent yet, so the first beat is slightly abstract.
reasons.retention: The 1999 and 2003 lines are the turn, and they arrive on time. The scroll sequences risk feeling like texture rather than progress.
reasons.originality: Old hardware still connected is familiar; the inversion that the modern life is the echo is not.
reasons.twist: Full marks. It reverses the direction of the entire story rather than adding to it.
reasons.visual: CRT phosphor and a loft. Atmospheric but text-heavy, and text is the hardest thing to read on a phone.
reasons.clarity: Docked. 'He is three seconds behind' requires the viewer to hold two timelines at once, and at 0:45 there is no room left to help them.

notes: Approved. Clarity is the weak dimension; the sound design carries the final beat and must land.
